name: Your first weeks helper
description: Answers everyday questions about your first day and first weeks: where to go, who you will meet and what to expect.

examples: What happens on my first day?
Where do I go on day one?
intents.answer: Arrive at 9am and ask for your Line Manager at reception. Your first morning is a welcome, your device and meeting your team.
Wear what you would for a client meeting on your first day. After that, follow what your team does.
Your buddy is a colleague who has been here a while. They are there for the small questions, and will say hello before you start.
